answer: Answer rewards vest across a challenge window, not at once, and each payout docks at a wharf before leaving. Any peer may post a bond and demand the text be re-derived from the epoch seed; if it cannot be tied to that key as original work, the challenger takes the bond and the balance burns. Provenance links keys funded from one deposit, so one upheld challenge voids the cluster. Rewards are nectar, and a system without this checkpoint is a karst, leaking value everywhere. Each extra puppet adds locked capital and shared risk, not yield, so growth is capped by the vesting clock.
